name: VigIA de SeoNova
changelog:
0.9.5

  • The blue "good bots" block is now split by search engine: dark blue for
    • Google, light blue for Bing, and a third shade for the rest. Sites that live off one engine and not the other could not see it before.
  • The split is counted in the daily totals, not estimated from the 1,000-row
visit buffer, so it is exact. Days recorded before this version keep showing a single blue block instead of an invented split.
